# Pravdeep Kullar

> Full-stack developer based in Ontario, Canada. Builds applications end to end in React, Next.js, and Node. Currently a software developer at Mentera, an AI platform for private practices and medspas. Completed a graduate certificate in AI and machine learning at Humber Polytechnic (2026).

## Background
- Software Developer at Mentera (2026 to present)
- Software Developer at Rebelsnow (2024 to 2025)
- Graduate certificate, AI with Machine Learning, Humber Polytechnic (January to August 2026)
- Diploma, Computer Programming, Humber Polytechnic
- Meta Front-End Developer certification
- Meta UI/UX Design certification

## Core stack
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase, FastAPI, Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Claude API

## Selected work
- Tera (Mentera): canvas panel that renders the AI assistant's output as it streams in. https://mentera.ai
- Making sites fast and findable: performance and SEO work on Mentera and Rosehill. PageSpeed 96/100 and 90/100 (mobile/desktop).
- Rosehill Design Build: freelance site rebuild for a GTA construction contractor. https://www.rosehilldesignbuild.com/
- Rising Sun Montessori School: school site with program-based navigation. https://risingsunmontessori.org/
- Rebelsnow: e-commerce storefront with catalog, cart, checkout, and payment. https://www.rebel-snow.com/
- FakeWordle: real-time multiplayer Wordle clone. https://www.fakewordle.com
- Schedule to calendar: turns a timetable screenshot into a calendar file using the Claude vision API. https://schedule-to-calendar-two.vercel.app
- Health risk classifier: capstone comparing logistic regression against a small neural network. Not public yet.
- HuntigoX: capstone that checks job postings against fraud patterns. Not public yet.
